summary: Fall Ball 2026 wrap-up with the season numbers, how Fall Ball works, and a Spring 2027 registration button; the 2025 rule PDFs and age charts come off. Why: last season's rules are stale and the next step is spring.
blurb: Fall Ball 2026 is a wrap: sign up for Spring 2027, and how Fall Ball works.

sources.fact: Fall Ball 2026 sponsors: Molen Orthodontics, Great Northwest Dental, Northwest Cascade.
Fall Ball supported 32 teams in 2025, up from 5 in 2024 (team bars).
Fall Ball 2026 registration opened Jul 10 and ran through Aug 9; limited fields meant some divisions could fill early and go to a waitlist.
Fall Ball 2025 registration was open by Jul 17, 2025.

Fall Ball 2026: practices began mid-August; Saturday games Sep 12 to Oct 31; developmental season, register for the division expected in the spring; 8 divisions (Tee Ball co-ed; Baseball Coach Pitch, AA, Minors, Majors; Softball Minors B, Minors A, Majors); spring volunteers' background checks and Abuse Awareness courses stay valid.
Fall Ball is a great entry point to try coaching; coaches sign up through the player's registration.
Fall Ball 2026 is over; coaches return gear to the Daffodil Shed, Sat Nov 7, 10AM to 1PM.
Nov 1 minutes: registration Black Friday Nov 27 to 29 ($50 off per family), Early Bird Nov 30 to Dec 31 ($25 off), full price Jan 1, 2027.

later: VP of Baseball (Jeremy Olsen) and VP of Softball (Luke Kress): confirm next fall runs the same way (weekday practices starting in August, Saturday games, games against nearby leagues) and whether Juniors will be offered (it was not in Fall 2026).
VP of Baseball and VP of Softball: the age cutoffs and registration dates for Fall 2027 (spring 2028 league age), to replace the Fall 2025 age chart on this page.

VP of Baseball (Jeremy Olsen): Minors age conflict. The 2025 Fall Ball guidelines said 'AAA (Minors player pitch) 10 to 11', while the FAQ, Registration and League Age pages say Minors 9 to 11. One answer is needed before a Fall 2027 chart goes up.
VP of Softball (Luke Kress), for the kept Fall 2027 chart: OK to show a softball cutoff as 'Age on Dec 31' (the 2025 page said 'as of January 1', the same rule)?
VP of Baseball and VP of Softball: the Fall 2027 District 10 rule PDFs when the district releases them. The 2025 PDFs sit in modules/fallball-rules.html, off the page until then.

Removed 11/4 under Coach's audience standard: modules/fallball-ages.html (Fall 2025 cutoffs) and modules/fallball-rules.html (2025 District 10 interlock PDFs, coach material) no longer insert after the Fall Ball block; about two phone screens of 2025 content on a page whose one job is Spring 2027 registration. To put them back, restore the two insert_after entries in this file.
Scheduler (Daniel Grande): confirm the one line left from the scoreboard (36 teams, Sep 12 to Oct 31). It comes from the schedule, not social media.

Sponsorship and Fundraising (Ashley Gauthier), optional: logos for the three Fall Ball 2026 sponsors (Molen Orthodontics, Great Northwest Dental, Northwest Cascade). The page thanks them by name until then.
long_summary: Fall Ball 2026 wrap-up with one job: the hero's big button is Spring 2027 registration (opens Friday, Nov 27, no prices). Then four short How Fall Ball works cards with the season at a glance (July, mid-August, Sep to Oct) and the sponsor thank-you, and the page ends there. Scoreboard, growth bars, timeline, division chips, gear-return and discount lines removed; the Fall 2025 age guidelines and 2025 District 10 rule PDFs are off the page too (the hero's League Age route answers which division; both files stay in modules/ for Fall 2027).
